description: Use when you need dated, source-linked coverage of an AI-engineering product, company or topic (agents, MCP, coding tools, model releases) without crawling the web. Keyword search (English, word forms match) over Field Notes (every news story), Signals, analyses, patterns, shifts, dossiers, topic hubs, tool change logs and tested-tool experiments; title and phrase matches rank first. Up to 25 hits per call with title, date, summary and URL; pass next_offset as offset for more. Same results as GET https://newruntime.com/search.json. Free, no auth. Example: {"query": "MCP security", "kind": "post", "limit": 5}. Then get_record for the full text.

kind.description: post = Field Note (one per news story), signal = synthesis of 2+ notes, analysis = deep dive, pattern/shift = trends, system/project = dossiers, topic = hub.

offset.description: Skip this many hits: the next_offset of the previous call.

query.description: Words to look for (product, company, topic).

since.description: Only records dated on or after this ISO date.

name: search_archive

hint.description: When nothing matched: what to try.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; null on the last page.

published_at.description: Record date (same as date; GET /search.json name).

score.description: Relevance score; higher is better, comparable within one query.

summary.description: One-line summary (same as description; GET /search.json name).

url.description: newruntime.com page; pass it to get_record.

title: Search the New Runtime archive
